ModulePrefs.title: rod
ModulePrefs.author: Juan M. Aguirregabiria (http://tp.lc.ehu.es/jma.html); Fremont Teng; lookang
ModulePrefs.description: A rod is dropped from rest while its end points remain in contact with the vertical wall and the horizontal table. Friction is neglected and it is assumed the rod remains in a vertical plane. The simulation allows computing fall times and trajectories.
